# Happy Miles Tours and Travels Pvt. Ltd.

> A newly established, fully registered and licensed travel agency based in
> Kathmandu, Nepal. Happy Miles designs custom trips across Nepal for individual
> travellers and works in partnership with local guides, hotels, agencies and
> organizations.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Happy Miles Tours and Travels Pvt. Ltd.
- Trading name: Happy Miles Tours & Travel
- Location: Kaldhara, Kathmandu-17, Bagmati Province, Nepal
- Phone / WhatsApp: +977 9765340335
- Email: info@happymiles.com.np
- Website: https://happymiles.com.np
- Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Nepal Time (also open on request)
- Languages: English

## Registration & licensing
- Registered with the Office of the Company Registrar, Nepal.
- Registered for PAN with the Inland Revenue Department, Nepal.
- Licensed by the Bagmati Province Department of Tourism and Culture.
- Documents are published at https://happymiles.com.np/verification.html

## What we offer
- Custom, made-to-order travel packages for each individual customer (no fixed
  off-the-shelf packages at this time).
- Trip planning across Nepal — culture, adventure, pilgrimage and general tourism.
- A growing partner network for guides, hotels, agencies and organizations.

## Who we serve
- Travellers planning trips to Nepal.
- Guides, drivers, hotels and travel agencies seeking a fair partnership.
- Organizations (NGOs, companies, institutions) needing group travel, logistics
  or a verifiable travel partner in Nepal.
